name: scry
description: SessionStart checks that tell an agent session the true state of the world and establish that repository Markdown is untrusted historical material. Adds a PreToolUse gate requiring every subagent dispatch to choose its model (a blank model silently inherits the session's, which is how a week of premium allowance goes in one session), an advisory on first contact with a large, actively-worked source file, and a two-strike speed bump on expensive Elixir force-rebuilds. Available on demand via /scry.
